capabilities: Number headings level by level with per-level sequence, brackets, separator and suffix rules
Skip individual headings or subtrees with %%skip%% / %%skips%% markers
Keep [[note#heading]] links pointing at the right heading after renumbering
Save per-level rules as named styles and switch between them
Remove existing heading numbers with a reset command
disambiguation: Not a heading linting or protection tool; its job is adding and maintaining heading numbers.
extras: The linked video tutorial is in Chinese only; the plugin UI supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English. Beta builds are available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to number headings with custom per-level formats, and renumbering headings by hand breaks existing heading links.
summary: Heading numbering plugin that auto-numbers Markdown headings H1-H6 with per-level rules and keeps [[note#heading]] links in sync when numbers change.
